reading.title: Quiz Night
reading.text: Every month our school holds a general knowledge quiz. Teams of four answer questions about history, sport and science. Last time my team lost because of a lack of knowledge about geography. To the best of my knowledge, the capital of Australia is Sydney, I said, but I was wrong. It was Canberra! Our captain, Rustam, is very knowledgeable and he often shares his knowledge with the team. Next time, we will read more before the quiz, because we want to gain knowledge and win the cup.

reading.title: Saving Water
reading.text: Last summer our town had very little rain, and the river dropped. The council took emergency measures to save water. Gardens could only be watered in the evening, and car washes were closed for a month. Some people said these measures were too strict, but the mayor explained that half measures would not work. Schools also took measures, such as fixing taps and teaching children to turn them off. By September, the river was higher, and the temporary measures ended.
